## About
Jack's Auto Glass & Parts fixes car glass and sells auto parts in Philadelphia. Windshields, back glass, door glass, sunroofs, side mirrors, vent glass. We keep a large inventory of new and used glass, so a lot of the time we can get you sorted without a long wait.
Living in Philly, a smashed car window is just part of life. You don't need an appointment. Stop by, call ahead, or have us bring the job to you at home or at work. We're open Sundays too.
We also do window tinting, window motor repairs, windshield chip repairs and auto body repair and painting. Customers rate us 4 stars from 672 Google reviews, and a few of them come back mostly for the shop cats.

## Services
- Auto Glass Services: We install and replace windshields, rear vision glass, side mirrors, door glass, sunroofs, vent glass and back glass.
- Mobile Window Replacement Services: Have your auto glass fixed wherever you are, at home, at work or out running errands.
- Windshield Chip Repairs: Got a chip in the windshield? Bring it in before it turns into a crack.
- Window Motor Repairs: From manual window cranks on older, classic cars to new automatic window motors, we handle it all.
- Window Tinting: Replacing a tinted window? We can match the tint on your vehicle, so you don't have to go somewhere else.
- Used Car Parts: Parts for your vehicle. Give us a call and ask what we've got.
- Auto Body Repair and Painting: Body repair and paint work, right here at the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No appointment necessary. If you want a set time, appointments are available upon request.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open every day, Sundays included, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM.

Q: Can you work with my insurance?
A: Yes, we handle insurance claims for auto glass.

Q: Is there a guarantee on windshield work?
A: Yes. Windshield replacements come with a lifetime guarantee on all workmanship.

Q: How can I save on tinting or detailing?
A: Text JACKSGLASS to 85100 to receive 10% off your next window tint or car detailing service.
